<translate>
<!--T:5-->
'''Old Kai's Pillar''' stands in the Sacred Kai Plains of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sacred Kai Planet|Sacred Kai Planet]]. It's the home of [[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai|Old Kai]], the master who runs the Ultimate Challenge that unlocks the Ultimate form and gives you the [[Special:MyLanguage/Z Sword|Z Sword]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Who lives here == <!--T:6-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:7-->
'''[[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai|Old Kai]]''' teaches [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Infusion|Ki Infusion]], Healing Reduction and the Soul Punisher. His '''Unleash Power''' service starts the [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Minigames#Old Kai's Ultimate Challenge|Ultimate Challenge]] when your alignment is 62 or higher and your [[Special:MyLanguage/Potential Unlock|Potential Unlock]] is level 10. He needs Good alignment (61 or higher) to train you.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding it == <!--T:8-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:9-->
The pillar generates once per world, in the Sacred Kai Plains. First you need to reach the Sacred Kai Planet by [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]], which unlocks after [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest 23. Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate oldkai_pillar}} on the planet.
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:10-->
Like every master's home, the pillar can't be damaged by ki attacks (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Protection|Protection]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:11-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:12-->
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest 42, ''The Spirit Bomb Plan'': find Old Kai's Pillar and talk to Old Kai.
* Buu Saga quest 24, ''The Z Sword and Ultimate Power'', needs the Z Sword and the Ultimate skill, both from Old Kai's Ultimate Challenge.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/GT Saga|GT Saga]] quest 18, ''The Elder Kai's Advice'': find Old Kai's Pillar and talk to Old Kai.
</translate>
